你是课程页重规划器。质量门已证明当前页靠原 block 类型无法修好；请只重做这一页的骨架。
输出 JSON：{"scene":{完整 scene 骨架}}，不要解释。硬约束：
- scene id/kind 不变；保留同一教学位置，但可改 headline/lead/brief/notes 和 block 组合。
- blocks 只含 id/type/role/intent/size/可选 engine，不写最终内容；id 全局唯一。
- 每页一个可观察 objective、一个 keyClaim；标题写清所有必要前提。
- 二维曲面/等高线/几何轨迹用 sim + engine=widget；普通 graph/diagram 只表达概念关系，不能冒充坐标。
- 定量曲线必须由页面给出的公式直接计算，或清楚标为合成示意；不能用随手编的点冒充数学定义。
- 若现有 objective 本身要求一页塞两件事，可收窄目标；不要增加页数。

Reach for it whenever a page shows numeric comparison, trend over time, share/composition, or correlation — anything where seeing the shape of the numbers beats reading them. Prefer a chart over a table when magnitude/trend/relationship is the point; use a table only for exact nominal lookup where values are not being compared. Produces schema-valid chart block JSON.", "runnable": "Author a runnable (edit → Run) code cell block for a LectureDoc lecture — an in-browser Python (Pyodide) + JavaScript editor with a console and a result chart. Use a plain `code` block instead for read-only display the student will not run. Produces schema-valid freeform block JSON.", "stats": "Author stats (KPI number cards), diagram (fixed structural shapes — cycle/pyramid/staircase/snake/arrow-seq/circular-grid/connected-circles) and graph (true node-edge trees, DAGs and branching flowcharts, rendered as real layered SVG) blocks for a LectureDoc lecture. Reach for stats to spotlight a handful of standalone key numbers; reach for graph whenever nodes have *named relationships* — parent/child, dependency, branch, merge — since it is the only block type with an edges field; reach for diagram only for a fixed decorative shape with no explicit edges. Produces schema-valid quiz block JSON.", "sim": "Author a sim (simulation) block for a LectureDoc lecture — a parameter-driven interactive that recomputes and redraws in-browser as the student changes inputs. Reach for it whenever a quantitative or mechanistic process becomes clearer by letting the student turn a knob and watch the outcome change (physics/chem dynamics, algorithm behaviour, parameter sensitivity); pick a sim over a static chart when the interaction itself is the teaching point. Engines are chosen at build time: dynamics1d/searchCompare (declarative restricted-expression math → line charts), custom (sandboxed compute), widget (live canvas/SVG animation, geometric construction, or arbitrary mouse interaction). Skip it when the topic has no quantifiable/mechanistic process to manipulate — a sim with no real parameter to turn is decoration, not interaction. Produces schema-valid sim block JSON."}, "currentBrief": {"objective": "学生能写出梯度下降的迭代公式，并解释凸函数下 O(1/T) 收敛率以及强凸函数下线性收敛的意义。", "keyClaim": "梯度下降在凸函数上以 O(1/T) 速率收敛到全局最优，在强凸函数上线性收敛。", "misconception": "认为梯度下降在任何函数上都保证收敛到全局最优。", "visualTask": "展示凸函数与非凸函数下梯度下降路径的对比，突出收敛行为差异。", "evidencePolicy": "synthetic"}, "currentScene": {"id": "mathematics", "kind": "content", "eyebrow": "数学形式", "headline": "梯度下降的迭代公式与收敛条件", "lead": "在凸函数上，若步长 η ≤ 1/L（L 为 Lipschitz 常数），则梯度下降以 O(1/T) 速率收敛；在强凸函数上，若步长 η ≤ 2/(μ+L)，则线性收敛。", "notes": "给出梯度下降的精确数学定义，并介绍凸函数下的收敛性质。", "blocks": [{"type": "formula", "latex": "\\theta_{t+1} = \\theta_t - \\eta \\nabla f(\\theta_t)", "caption": "梯度下降迭代公式，η 为学习率", "id": "b_math_formula"}, {"type": "compare", "left": {"caption": "凸函数", "block": {"type": "callout", "label": "success", "title": "全局收敛", "text": "梯度下降在凸函数上 **全局收敛**，路径单调下降。例如 $f(x)=x^2$，从 $x_0=10$ 以步长 $\\eta=0.1$ 迭代，$x_{t+1}=0.8x_t$，迅速趋近 $0$。收敛速率 $O(1/T)$，步长需满足 $\\eta \\leq 1/L$（$L$ 为 Lipschitz 常数）。", "formula": "x_{t+1}=x_t-\\eta\\nabla f(x_t)"}}, "right": {"caption": "非凸函数", "block": {"type": "callout", "label": "warning", "title": "可能陷入局部最优", "text": "梯度下降在非凸函数上可能 **陷入局部极小值** 或鞍点，路径曲折。例如 $f(x)=x^4-4x^2+4$，有两个局部极小 $x=\\pm\\sqrt{2}$。从 $x_0=1$ 出发，步长 $\\eta=0.1$ 收敛到 $x\\approx1.414$；从 $x_0=-1$ 出发则收敛到 $x\\approx-1.414$。步长过大可能越过谷底，过小则收敛缓慢。", "formula": "f(x)=x^4-4x^2+4"}}, "id": "b_math_compare"}, {"type": "list", "items": [{"lead": "凸函数", "text": "步长 $η \\leq 1/L$（$L$ 为 Lipschitz 常数）时，梯度下降以 $O(1/T)$ 速率收敛到全局最优。", "icon": "trending-down"}, {"lead": "强凸函数", "text": "步长 $η \\leq 2/(μ+L)$（$μ$ 为强凸参数）时，梯度下降线性收敛。", "icon": "trending-down"}], "id": "b_math_list"}], "layout": {"kind": "compose", "areas": [{"blockIds": ["b_math_formula"], "col": [1, 7]}, {"blockIds": ["b_math_compare"], "col": [1, 9]}, {"blockIds": ["b_math_list"], "col": [9, 13]}]}}, "qualityIssues": ["未实现brief.visualTask要求的凸函数与非凸函数下梯度下降路径的对比展示。当前页面仅有文字描述，缺少可视化元素（如图表或动画）来直观对比收敛行为差异。需要添加一个chart或animation block来展示路径对比，并确保首帧同时显示凸函数和非凸函数的路径（或提供无需猜测的切换机制）。", "左边callout使用强凸函数f(x)=x^2作为凸函数的例子，并声称收敛速率O(1/T)，但强凸函数实际线性收敛，与O(1/T)不符。这会导致学生混淆凸函数与强凸函数的收敛速率。；修改左边callout文本，明确区分一般凸函数（O(1/T)）和强凸函数（线性收敛）。可以将例子f(x)=x^2标注为强凸函数，并说明其线性收敛，同时补充一个一般凸函数的例子（如f(x)=x^4，但需注意Lipschitz条件）或调整表述，确保收敛速率与例子匹配。", "右边callout描述非凸函数时称'路径曲折'，但所给一维例子从x0=1到x≈1.414的路径是单调的，并无曲折，描述与例子不符。；修改右边callout文本，将'路径曲折'改为'可能陷入局部极小'或'收敛到不同局部极小'，以准确反映例子。"]}
